evals.prompt: /study-walkthrough event sourcing (where wiki page exists at depth 2 with 4 flashcards)
evals.expected_output: Skill should: (1) find existing page via TreeSearch + Ollama + wiki index, (2) find flashcards via find_similar_cards, (3) show existing coverage with depth info, (4) ask 1-2 targeted recall questions, (5) calibrate and adapt

assertions.text: Searches TreeSearch, Ollama semantic search, AND find_similar_cards
Shows existing page with depth and last_deepened metadata
Asks 1-2 recall questions from existing wiki content or flashcard backs
Differentiates between solid/partial/poor recall
Starts with Phase 1/4: Discovery & Calibration

evals.prompt: (Developer fails a recall question about projections during study-walkthrough on event sourcing)
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT skip past the gap. It should drill into projections with simpler sub-concepts, require explain-back, and not advance until the developer can articulate clearly

assertions.text: Does NOT move past the failed concept
Drills deeper with simpler sub-concepts or fresh examples
Asks developer to explain the concept back
Only advances when developer demonstrates understanding
Asks developer to generate their own example at least once

evals.prompt: /study-walkthrough event sourcing → write wiki (extending existing page)
evals.expected_output: Skill should extend the existing page with new sections, increment depth, set last_deepened, run scripts/wiki-write, log session with depth change

assertions.text: Extends existing page rather than creating new one
Increments depth frontmatter field
Sets last_deepened to today's date
Runs scripts/wiki-write
Session log includes depth change (e.g., depth: 2 → 3)

evals.expected_output: Skill should: (1) fetch the URL content, (2) NOT dump it raw into wiki, (3) use it as source material for the walkthrough, (4) check wiki index for existing pages on closures/javascript, (5) walk through interactively ensuring understanding, (6) write wiki page by default at the end

assertions.text: Attempts to fetch URL content via WebFetch
Does NOT create wiki page immediately from URL content
Walks through concepts interactively before writing
Checks wiki index for existing javascript/closures page
Enters write-focused mode and defaults to writing wiki at Phase 4

evals.expected_output: Skill should: (1) search and find no existing material, (2) ask one calibration question about current knowledge, (3) ask developer to choose page type, (4) walkthrough with full understanding checks, (5) write wiki page by default

assertions.text: Compresses calibration to single 'what do you already know?' question
Offers page type selection (Tutorial/Concept, Problem-Solution, Pattern/Technique, Feature/Tool Overview)
Starts with Phase 1/4: Discovery & Calibration
Proceeds to wiki write by default in Phase 4 without asking
